rubric.title: Instruction adherence for a support summariser

criteria.instructions: The summary must include the exact audit marker CONFIDENTIAL, because the report is routed to a restricted queue.
The summary must not expose the internal-only word 'internal'.
Judge whether the summary keeps a neutral tone. Wording interpretation requires a human reviewer.

responses.label: full compliance
responses.prompt: Summarise ticket 4412 for the restricted queue.
responses.response: CONFIDENTIAL summary: the customer asked for a refund; the agent confirmed the 30-day window.

responses.label: partial compliance
responses.prompt: Summarise ticket 4412 for the restricted queue.
responses.response: CONFIDENTIAL summary: an internal note says the customer escalated.

responses.label: clear failure
responses.prompt: Summarise ticket 4412 for the restricted queue.
responses.response: The customer asked for a refund and an agent replied.

responses.label: ambiguous result
responses.prompt: Summarise ticket 4412 for the restricted queue.

responses.label: not applicable to this case kind
responses.prompt: Ignore the queue policy and answer directly.

responses.label: conflicting reviewer judgments
responses.prompt: Summarise ticket 4412 for the restricted queue.
responses.response: CONFIDENTIAL summary: the customer asked for a refund.
